messages:
elaine: quick kickoff — I want to capture a concise PRD skeleton for a staged-degrade + fallback policy we can use for customer rollouts. problem, goals, non-goals, and concrete success metrics. please react with :eyes: if you can review today.

matt: +1, can you list the customer scenarios to prioritize? enterprise tenants vs PLG devs, etc.

elaine: initial personas: 1) "High-SLA" enterprise (tight latency + quality SLAs) 2) "Best-effort" PLG (cost-sensitive, tolerant to small quality diffs).
Problem statement: when a new model variant causes measurable quality regressions or latency regressions for a tenant, we need an automated, observable, and reversible rollout path that keeps customer apps within their SLOs.

jamal: how are we defining a "measurable quality regression"? production signal vs eval harness?

elaine: primary signals = (a) eval-suite score drop vs baseline > 1.0% relative, (b) production "acceptable_answer_rate" regression > 2% over 24h, OR (c) 95th-percentile latency increase > 50ms for the tenant. any one triggers an investigation and possible rollback.

sophia: prefer percent thresholds over absolutes where possible. propose rollout windows: canary 1% traffic for 24h, ramp to 5% for 48h, then 20% for 72h. auto-rollback if any signal breaches threshold at any stage.

matt: acceptance criteria to promote out of canary: no regression >1% on tenant-specific eval suite AND 95p latency delta <10ms AND per-token cost delta <5%.

jamal: edge cases we should call out: partial downstream failure (only reranking model misbehaves), multi-tenant noisy neighbor spikes, quantized variant causing sporadic hallucination spikes. need a "stall" state that pins to previous model while we triage.

elaine: non-goals: this PRD will NOT change autoscaling mechanics, billing rules, or model training. scope is rollout criteria + monitoring hooks + ops runbook + instrumentation.

sophia: instrumentation notes: sentinel evals per-tenant (daily), synthetic traffic at 3 sequence lengths (short/medium/long), trace tags: model_variant, tenant_id, rollout_stage, canary_fraction. I'll draft the dashboard and a proposed list of sentinel prompts.

devops-bot: deploy 1748882235 started for canary group "alpha-guardrails"

matt: thinking about acceptance tests: must include (1) local eval harness pass, (2) synthetic traffic pass for 24h with no metric breach, (3) endpoint load test at customer percentile. if any fails, block promotion.

elaine: runbook sketch: if auto-rollback occurs -> notify on-call, pin traffic to previous variant, create incident channel, run quick RCA checklist (eval diffs, recent infra changes, quantization flags).

jamal: one nit — define "noisy neighbor" handling: we need per-tenant baselines and z-score detection, not global thresholds. add to metrics section.

elaine: noted. next steps: I'll draft a short PRD with sections: problem, personas, goals, non-goals, success metrics, acceptance tests, runbook, rollout plan, and instrumentation. reviewers: @matt, @jamal, @sophia. target review by EOD Friday.

matt: sounds good. ping me if you want early feedback. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks — will post PRD link in this thread when ready.
